name: n8n
description: Techlio builds and maintains n8n workflows and AI agents for business automation: bookings, orders, invoices, reporting and internal operations.
h1: n8n workflows and AI agents, *built to keep running.*
answer: n8n is a workflow automation platform that connects business apps and can run AI agents inside a workflow. Techlio designs, builds and maintains n8n automations for companies that want control over their data, logic and running cost, with error handling, logging and a human approval step for unusual cases.

builds.title: Business automations
builds.text: Bookings, order intake, invoice processing, follow-ups and reporting connected across the tools you already use.

builds.title: AI agents inside workflows
builds.text: Agents that read a request, look up facts in your systems, and act, with memory, tools and a vector store where needed.

builds.title: Self-hosted and managed setups
builds.text: n8n deployed in your own cloud for data control, with monitoring, backups, upgrades and credentials owned by your company.

fits: Automation is becoming core to how the business runs
Customer or patient data must stay in your own environment
Volumes are high enough that per-task pricing on other platforms adds up
Workflows need custom code, branching logic or AI agents

faqs.question: Do you host n8n for us?
faqs.answer: We deploy it in your cloud account or use n8n's hosted plan, whichever fits your data and budget. Either way the account and credentials belong to you.

faqs.question: Can you take over workflows someone else built?
faqs.answer: Yes. We review them first for error handling, security and maintainability, then fix the highest risks before adding more.

faqs.question: Is n8n right for a small business?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. A few well-built workflows can remove hours of weekly admin. If nobody will maintain it, we will say so and suggest a simpler tool.
